audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Pantheon six of seven stages including first item and 2+ items, in a lane Kayle wins 54.52% and which the file itself calls a hyper-carry scaling win ('This is where you take everything back').
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle. Pantheon is the canonical early bully who falls off into items; giving him the item stages tells a player to give up exactly the window she wins.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4, 5 and 6 -> Kayle; rows 0-2 stay Pantheon. Flipped in matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly sited, and the mirror pass already fixed the Divine Ascent breakpoints — ranged form at 6, fire waves at 11, Transcendent at 16 — which this side's spikes[1] and spikes[2] already reflect.

audit.whatIsWrong: Asserted four times: 'his Aegis passive blocks your basic autos'. Aegis Assault is Pantheon's E, not his passive, it is a channelled set-up rather than an always-on block, and Riot's text says he becomes invulnerable to damage from the FRONT — direction matters and it costs him an 18-22 second cooldown. His actual passive is Mortal Will, which empowers every few spells or attacks. Packet also flags that no Pantheon ability is ever named.
audit.why: A player told the block is passive concludes he can never be traded with. In truth it is directional, costs 80 mana and 22s at rank 1, and the empowered spear is telegraphed by Mortal Will stacks. Shield Vault is also a point-click dash-stun that resets his auto — the wind-up, not the cast, is the step-back cue.
audit.corrected: Name Aegis Assault (E) as an 18-22s frontal block, name Comet Spear, Shield Vault and Mortal Will, and give Shield Vault's 13/12/11/10/9s and its auto reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] warns about a 'W execute' with generic filler text. Shield Vault has no execute in Riot's description — it dashes, damages and stuns.
audit.why: Inventing an execute changes how a player plays low HP against him for no reason; the real tell is the dash-stun's auto reset.
audit.corrected: Replaced the description with the dash-stun-plus-auto-reset fact and its 13s rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Shield Vault's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Celestial Blessing and Radiant Blast's armour-and-MR shred are online; punish the 13s after Shield Vault whiffs and bank the farm lead.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Pantheon's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and Divine Judgment blanks the Shield Vault all-in — he has no gap-closer left to reach you once you kite back.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Shield Vault's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's lands and E's missing-health on-hit bullies a Pantheon who is already falling off.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Pantheon carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Ranged AoE waves under R melt him and his point-click burst no longer threatens your health bar.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Shield Vault dashes, stuns and resets his auto — 13s at rank 1.

edits.before: His Aegis passive blocks your basic autos and he out-trades you; with only Q you can't punish his stun, so concede the CS.
edits.after: Aegis Assault (E) blocks damage from his front and he out-trades you; with only Q you cannot punish the stun, so concede the CS.

edits.before: Pantheon's W is a point-click stun he can throw the instant you step up to last-hit, into an empowered Q spear that can flat-kill a melee Kayle with no W sustain yet — and his Aegis passive blocks your basic autos so you can't even trade back.
edits.after: Shield Vault (W) is a point-click dash-stun with an auto reset, thrown the instant you step up, into a Mortal Will empowered Comet Spear that flat-kills a melee Kayle — and Aegis Assault blocks damage from his front, so you cannot trade back.

edits.before: Use his Aegis passive to block your basic autos and win every extended trade levels 1-5
edits.after: Set Aegis Assault to block your damage from the front and win every extended trade levels 1-5

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stabilize a little as W sustain and Q poke (it shreds his armor AND MR, not just armor) come online, but you still lose every extended trade to his Aegis auto-block and burst, so keep farming safe and waiting for 6. Level 6 is the whole lane: Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with AoE magic waves and R gives you a few seconds of full invulnerability — now when he W-stuns and dives, you R through the burst and kite him with ranged autos while he has no real gap-closer to reach you. Don't fight him before 6; the second you have it, you can start trading from range he can't answer.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stabilize a little as W sustain and Q poke (it shreds his armor AND MR, not just armor) come online, but you still lose extended trades to Aegis Assault's frontal block and his burst, so farm safe and wait for 6. Level 6 is the whole lane: Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with AoE magic waves and R gives you a few seconds of full invulnerability — now when he Shield Vaults in, you R through the burst and kite with ranged autos while he has no gap-closer left. Don't fight before 6; the second you have it, trade from range he can't answer.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are the worst part of this lane and you have to respect it. Pantheon's W is a point-click stun, so the instant you step up to last-hit he can stun you, drop an empowered Q spear, and trade you down or flat-kill you — and his Aegis passive blocks your basic autos, so you can't even fight back cleanly. You are still melee, with only Q and one point of W, no escape and no way to punish his all-in. Concede CS, take last-hits at the safe edge of Q range, and do NOT walk into his stun trying to contest. The goal is just to be alive and not 20 CS down at 6.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are the worst part of this lane and you have to respect it. Shield Vault is a point-click dash-stun on 13s, so the instant you step up he stuns you, drops a Mortal Will empowered Comet Spear, and trades you down or flat-kills you — and Aegis Assault blocks damage from his front for 22s of cooldown, so you can't fight back cleanly. You are melee, with one point of W, no escape and no way to punish the all-in. Concede CS, last-hit at the safe edge of Q range, and do NOT walk into the stun. Be alive at 6, not 20 CS down.

notes: Kit derives a 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it' flag on Aegis Assault; Riot's description does not say it is interruptible, so that is left unasserted — the text only uses what the description states (invulnerable to damage from the front). Kayle has no hard CC to test it with anyway. diffRating and the report call this 'Hard 8.5/10' while diff is EVEN at 54.52% — inconsistent, left for a human.
